body_text:
Let $\Gamma$ be a collection of sentences and let $\varphi$ be
a sentence in the same language. We say that $\varphi$ is a
*semantic consequence* of $\Gamma$, written
$\Gamma\models\varphi$, if every interpretation in which all
sentences of $\Gamma$ are true also makes $\varphi$ true. No
assertion is made that such an interpretation exists; if
$\Gamma$ is inconsistent, every sentence is a semantic
consequence of $\Gamma$.
